answer: A newcomer files a copper payslip with the terrace panel: a payslip from its employer, the payroll number and signature checked against the ripple registry within thirty minutes of the nonce. The terrace panel matches the payslip, the payroll number, and the signature. A payslip reused under a second name fails, and the record is barred for a cycle, forfeiting thirty units. An honest worker pays thirty units once; a thousand fakes pay thirty thousand units. A farm reusing one payslip for a thousand clones fails: one payroll record binds one employee to one copper.
